summary: Iteration 6: tested the redesigned conversational onboarding and ran a regression sweep. Backend: 97/97 pytest passed. Frontend: the whole hands-free flow works with a fake mic (getUserMedia was overridden to stream /tmp/onb_*.mp3): name -> 'My name is Mike.' -> truck ('13-foot-6, 53-foot trailer, 80,000 pounds, no hazmat.') -> prefs ('Avoid tolls, I like Loves and Pilot, remind me every four hours' turned on avoid_tolls, picked Pilot and Love's, set break 4h) -> 'All set, Mike!' -> map. Everything saved to localStorage. Also verified: the avatar is centered at 375 and 390 widths, the thought bubble shows only the short question, and Type instead sits at the bottom. A quiet mic (noise floor about -54 dB) shows 'Tap me to answer, or type it.' after 7s, and tapping the avatar listens again. Type instead path: name is trimmed, the truck step goes back to conversation mode, an invalid truck shows the error and disables Next. Mic denied shows MicPermissionCard and dismissing it switches to typing. Skip, reopening from the menu (prefilled), and finishing from the menu all work, with only one map afterward and the route kept. Profile chip and hazmat badge update. Main map voice: Reno route works, the fuel search shows the other-options list, End route works, and saving in the truck-profile editor keeps the driver prefs. No console errors. No deprecated Expo packages detected. Remaining issues are layout and UX only.

ui_bugs.issue: At 375x667 the 150px avatar and thought bubble take the top ~370px. Weight, the hazmat toggle and the validation error sit below the sticky footer (error y=750, Next y=595), so the driver sees a disabled Next with no visible reason. Same at 390x844. The thought bubble is also partly clipped under the header.

issues: Only the two toggles fit above 'Save preferences'. The favorite-stop chips and break-reminder chips are off-screen (pref-break-off y=674), so the driver has to scroll. Use a smaller avatar on the prefs and typing steps.

Tapping the avatar after silence, or while it is speaking, replays the whole spoken line (~6s of TTS) before listening. The spec says the tap should re-listen right away. See onboarding.tsx onAvatar -> converse -> say(spoken()).
'Sorry, I didn't catch that.' is never shown on the first failure: status is '' while mode=speaking and then 'Listening…'. It only appears if the TTS is heard.
The truck summary (onboarding-truck-summary) shows the default 13 ft 6 in · 53 ft · 80,000 lb before the driver says anything, so it looks already answered.
When the options sheet is open, the agent reply bubble covers the menu button and the truck profile chip.
map-destination-label runs off the right edge (shows 'Reno, NV, Un…').

action_items: Onboarding typing mode and prefs: make the avatar smaller (e.g. 80-96px) when typing or on the prefs step, and/or show onboarding-truck-error right above the Next button so it is always visible.
onAvatar: when re-tapped after silence or 'didn't catch', go straight to voice.listen() (or say only the short question). When mode==='speaking', stop the TTS and start listening.
Show NOT_CAUGHT in onboarding-heard while re-asking (don't blank the status while speaking).

Truck step: if the parse returns only some fields (e.g. only height), consider asking for the missing ones instead of quietly keeping the defaults. Hide the default summary until the driver answers, or label it 'current'.
Map: keep the agent reply bubble out of the top-bar area when the sheet is tall, and limit map-destination-label to the screen width.
critical_code_review_comments: onboarding.tsx: converse() advances when ANY key is returned (got = keys>0). A partial truck answer moves on and silently keeps the default trailer and weight.
onboarding.tsx: useEffect([saved]) resets the draft every time the saved object reference changes. If saved arrives late, a voice answer given before then could be overwritten. Low risk.
useVoice.listen: with no metering it uses a fixed 7s window and then always sends the audio (saw this with a fake stream that produced no frames). On a real mic the metering path works.
onboarding.tsx is 532 lines, under the 700-line limit. testIDs present. No deprecated packages (expo-audio is used).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass; 1 medium and several low layout/UX issues

seed_data_creation: None in DB. Browser localStorage was seeded with truck_profile_v1 and onboarded_v1 for map tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fake-mic technique without ffmpeg: in browser_automation, page.route('**/__fake/*.mp3') serves the bytes of /tmp/onb_name.mp3 / onb_truck.mp3 / onb_prefs.mp3 / reno.mp3 / q.mp3. add_init_script overrides navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia to return an AudioContext MediaStreamDestination stream playing the decoded mp3 (window.__next selects the file), and overrides navigator.permissions.query for microphone to 'granted'. For silence, use low random noise (amp 0.002); a stream with no source gives no metering. For mic denied, make getUserMedia throw NotAllowedError and have the query return 'denied'. Backend tests need EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL exported.
